## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …). It becomes the squash commit and drives the release version.
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm gen:config:check` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the change
- [ ] Docs / `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No credentials, tokens or private URLs in code, tests, fixtures or screenshots
